discrepancy_note: the coordinator dispatched this review with a reconstructed run id rather than one copied from the pointer listing; the reviewer detected the mismatch, recorded the real run id as reviewed_run_id_actual, and scored the correct run. The coordinator re-keyed the record to the real run id and preserved the dispatched value under dispatched_reviewed_run_id. The verdict is unchanged.

findings.text: the insufficient-evidence detail reports a sample shortfall of {samples} against the floor of 10 without establishing that samples is why the cost is missing: a lane with 12 usable runs whose coordinator reading is absent hits capabilities.py:611 (median_input None) and the clause tells the caller "12 usable run(s), 10 needed", a count the reader can already see is met, while input_samples counts that shortfall at dispatch.py:1995 and is never carried into the clause.

the live dispatch record assembles lane_declaration and lane_reading and omits lane_advisory, so the ledger read and cheaper-lane clause computed at dispatch.py:2854-2856 on every emitting real dispatch are discarded with no reader anywhere in reckon/ outside as_dict; the deferral is the plan's, but the cost is paid on the path that cannot show it.
